improvements: Strict whole supplied price frames require matching array lengths, unique ascending dates and finite positive prices. Duplicates, future or invalid dates, boolean/negative/nonfinite prices withhold returns without silently sorting or dropping rows.

Each return preserves its exact event date, start/end row, dates, closes, formula, decimal-return value and complete/partial/unavailable reason. A missing prior close only withholds same-day arithmetic; valid forward observations survive.

Every event group and whole supplied price frame is retained once in the comparison input ledger. Partial current-UTC-date endpoints are excluded from summaries with separate candidate/complete/partial/unavailable counts.
New ordinary proxy acquisitions keep all raw consumed time/close fields and rows, including missing closes and pre-1995 dates. No extra provider route or native invocation is added.

Requested symbol, returned symbol, declared count and every normalized time/close must agree with retained consumed fields. Original provider authenticity and adjusted-price definitions remain explicitly unverified.
Empty/failed acquisitions retain the old frame with its original acquisition date and a separate latest-attempt status. Future cache timestamps do not make a cache fresh.

Offline CLI rebuilds complete frame identity, validations, event grouping, coverage and distributions; altered inputs, permissions and mismatched reported statistics are rejected. No archived code is executed.

Existing output keys, descriptive predictions, native resources and schedules remain. Original-source and historical-price display gates remain false; supplied-input replay grants no forecasting or position-sizing permission.

synthetic_capacity.scope: Local synthetic shared reaction compiler only; not native whole-handler capacity

limitations: All ten platform workstreams remain open. This arithmetic repair does not establish causal auction-release response, predictive accuracy or supported portfolio sizing.

Proxy closes have upstream warehouse/Yahoo normalization. Retained proxy inputs are not raw provider originals; corporate actions, close definitions, exchange-session completeness and original vintages remain unverified.
Legacy cache rows cannot recover observations that earlier code or upstream normalization already removed. Legacy population completeness remains unverified.
Forward horizons count supplied observations, not verified exchange sessions. Same-day compares prior close with event-day close; current UTC-day endpoints conservatively remain partial.
The full synthetic 14-asset, 11228-observation, 1604-event ledger costs 14770160 uncompressed JSON bytes. Native whole-handler peak capacity and payload delivery optimization remain separate work.
Complete supplied event-group replay does not prove the historical grading model, original source population, or first-publication availability. Grade and source-bank qualification remain separate.
Ordinary publication is distinct from exact code/package/static acceptance; the existing schedules are unchanged.

static_acceptance.scope: Whole static HTML, existing script and generated registries only. No execution or current/private packet requests.
